x-k-k5-07.title: Ogeysiis safar dugsi oo leh dhibaato wakhti
x-k-k5-07.goal: Hel isku dhaca ogeysiiska safarka, go'aami waxa la gabagabeyn karo, oo qor su'aal edeb leh oo xalisa.
x-k-k5-07.material: Fasalkaaga wuxuu helay ogeysiiskan macallinka fariin.
x-k-k5-07.thinking.1: Go'aaminta waxa aan lagu gabagabeyn karin qoraalka oo keliya
x-k-k5-07.s.s1.prompt: Taabo HAL ka mid ah labada xariiq ee wakhtiyadoodu labadaba sax noqon karin.
x-k-k5-07.s.s1.hint.0: Ku dhig wakhtiyada saacadda xariiqyada nidaamka oo is barbardhig.
x-k-k5-07.s.s1.hint.1: Hubi dhacdada la yidhi marka hore timaado, ka dibna hubi wakhtiyada.
x-k-k5-07.s.s1.explain: Xariiqyada 3 iyo 4 way isku dhacaan: fasalku wuxuu gaaraa beerta 11:30, laakiin qadada 'ka dib imaanshaha' waa 11:00. Xariiqyada 1, 2 iyo 5 waa isku waafaqsan yihiin.
x-k-k5-07.s.s2.prompt: Maxaad hubin kartaa, maxaadse sameyn lahayd?
x-k-k5-07.s.s2.hint.0: Weydii haddii qoraalku bixiyo hab lagu go'aamiyo labada wakhti.
x-k-k5-07.s.s2.hint.1: Ka fikir waxa dhacaya haddii aad khalad qiyaasto.
x-k-k5-07.s.s2.o.a: Qoraalku ma muujin karo wakhtiga khaldan, sidaas darteed weydii macallinka
x-k-k5-07.s.s2.r.a: Labada xariiqba midkoodna wuu khaldami karaa; weydiintu waa hab keliya oo lagu barto wakhtiga runta ah.
x-k-k5-07.s.s2.o.b: Wakhtiga imaanshaha ayaa khaldan, sidaas darteed qadada runtii waa 11:00
x-k-k5-07.s.s2.r.b: Wakhti kastaba wuxuu noqon karaa khalad higgaad; qoraalku ma sheego kuwee.
x-k-k5-07.s.s2.o.c: Wakhtiga qadada ayaa khaldan, sidaas darteed qadada runtii waa 12:00
x-k-k5-07.s.s2.r.c: Ogeysiiska waxba ma bixiyaan 12:00; tani waxay ku dari lahayd xaqiiqo.
x-k-k5-07.s.s2.o.d: Labadaba waa sax: fasalku wuxuu cunaa qado ka hor intaanu gaarin beerta
x-k-k5-07.s.s2.r.d: Xariiqda 4 waxay leedahay qadada waa ka dib imaanshaha, sidaas darteed labadaba sax ma noqon karaan.
x-k-k5-07.s.s2.explain: Isku dhac wuxuu muujiyaa inuu wax khaldan yahay, ma aha waxa. Macluumaad dheeraad ah la'aanteed, qiyaasidda 11:00 ama 12:00 waxay kugu keeni kartaa inaad daahdo ama goor hore tagto.
x-k-k5-07.s.s3.prompt: Qor fariin edeb leh macallinka Kuuriyaan ah oo weydiisanaysa wakhtiga saxda ah.
x-k-k5-07.s.s3.hint.0: Magacaaw labada faahfaahin (도착, 점심) ee aad rabto inaad is barbar dhigto.
x-k-k5-07.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Fariintaydu ma tilmaamtaa labada faahfaahin ee is dhaca?
x-k-k5-07.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Macallinku ma ka jawaabi karaa hal eray ama tiro?
x-k-k5-07.s.s3.modelNote.1: Wuxuu magacaabaa dhibaatada erayo cad ka hor intaanu weydiin.

x-k-k5-03.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Ma ku haysay dhammaadka edebta leh?
x-k-k5-03.title: Su'aashee ayaan u baahanahay inaan weydiiyo?
x-k-k5-03.topic: fariimaha qorshaha: weydiinta waxa aad u baahan tahay
x-k-k5-03.goal: Go'aami qaybaha macluumaadka ee maqan ee aad u baahan tahay ka hor intaadan aqbalin casumaad, kadibna weydii iyaga oo kaliya Kuuriyaan edeb leh.
x-k-k5-03.material:
Saaxiibkaaga fasalka Hana ayaa dirta fariintan Arbacada. Sabtida waxaad shaqeysaa ilaa 1:00 p.m., waxaadna mari kartaa ugu badnaan 10,000 won howsha.
하나: 이번 토요일에 서울숲에서 자전거를 탈 거예요. 자전거는 한 시간에 5,000원이에요. 같이 갈래요?
x-k-k5-03.thinking.0: Isku jaanqaadinta macluumaadka maqan iyo xadadkaaga
x-k-k5-03.thinking.1: Iska indho tirka faahfaahin xiiso leh laakiin aan quseyn
x-k-k5-03.thinking.2: Samaynta su'aal cad oo ku saabsan qorshe mustaqbal
x-k-k5-03.prereq.0: Wuxuu akhriyaa casumaadaha leh -(으)ㄹ 거예요 iyo -(으)ㄹ래요?
x-k-k5-03.prereq.1: Wuxuu weydiin karaa su'aalo edeb leh oo leh 몇 시, 언제
x-k-k5-03.s.s1.prompt: LABA shay ee aad tahay inaad ogaato ka hor intaadan odhan haa ama maya?
x-k-k5-03.s.s1.hint.0: Marka hore qor labadaada xad, kadibna weydii faahfaahinta maqan ee ku oggolaan lahayd inaad tijaabiso mid kasta.
x-k-k5-03.s.s1.hint.1: Doorasho kasta weydii: haddii aan taas ogaan lahaa, jawaabtayda haa/maya ma beddeli lahayd?
x-k-k5-03.s.s1.r.a: Nooca ma beddelo saacadaha shaqadaada ama miisaaniyaddaada, sidaas darteed jawaabtu kuma xirna.
x-k-k5-03.s.s1.o.b: Goorta ay bilaabi doonaan inay fuulaan
x-k-k5-03.s.s1.r.b: Shaqadaada Sabtida waxay dhammaataa 1:00, sidaas darteed waqtiga bilowga ayaa go'aamiya haddii maalintu xitaa suurtagal tahay.
x-k-k5-03.s.s1.r.c: Saaxiibadu way kuu muhiim noqon karaan, laakiin midna labadaada xad kuma xirna.
x-k-k5-03.s.s1.r.d: Waad u baahan doontaa mar dambe, laakiin weli waad aqbali kartaa ama diidi kartaa adigoon haysan.
x-k-k5-03.s.s1.o.e: Imisa saacadood ayay qorsheeyeen inay fuulaan
x-k-k5-03.s.s1.r.e: 5,000 won saacaddii, tirada saacadaha ayaa go'aamisa haddii aad ku jirto 10,000 won.
x-k-k5-03.s.s1.explain: Labadaada xad waa waqtiga dhammaadka shaqada (1:00) iyo miisaaniyad (10,000 won). Waqtiga bilowgu wuxuu jawaabaa xadka koowaad tirada saacadaha (laba jeer 5,000 won)-na xadka labaad.
x-k-k5-03.s.s2.prompt: Qor jawaabtaada Hana Kuuriyaan (qaab edeb leh): weydii su'aalaha aad doortay, adigoon wali odhan haa ama maya.
x-k-k5-03.s.s2.hint.0: Su'aal kasta waa inay waafaqsanaato mid ka mid ah labadaada xad.
x-k-k5-03.s.s2.hint.1: Isticmaal -(으)ㄹ 거예요? qorshaha, 몇 시 / 몇 시간 qadarrada.
x-k-k5-03.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ma fariintaydu waxay u oggolaaneysaa Hana inay ka jawaabto labada su'aalood hal jawaab?
x-k-k5-03.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ma cad tahay inaanan wali go'aansan?
x-k-k5-03.s.s2.modelNote.1: Wuxuu bixiyaa sabab weydiinta wuxuuna isticmaalaa 언제까지 muddada.

x-k-k5-01.title: Maxay Jisu u raagtay?
x-k-k5-01.goal: Dooro sharraxaadda ku habboon dhammaan tilmaamaha sheeko gaaban oo ku saabsan dhacdo hore, oo dheh tilmaanta ugu miisaan weyn iyo waxa weli aan la hubin.
x-k-k5-01.material:
Sheeko koox waxbarasho (스터디 단체 대화방) maalinta ka dib kulan. Jisu way soo daahay oo qofna si toos ah kama weydiin sababta.
민호: 어제 스터디에 지수 씨가 40분 늦게 왔어요.
하나: 맞아요. 처음에는 전화를 해도 안 받았어요.
민호: 도착했을 때 신발이 다 젖어 있었어요.
지수: 휴대폰이 꺼져서 연락을 못 했어요. 정말 죄송해요.
x-k-k5-01.thinking.0: Ka gaarista sabab aan la sheegin dhowr tilmaan
x-k-k5-01.prereq.0: Wuxuu akhriyaa fariimo sheeko gaaban oo waqtiga hore ah (-았/었어요)
x-k-k5-01.prereq.1: Wuu yaqaan -아서/어서 iyo raalli-gelin qaab edeb leh -요 sida 죄송해요
x-k-k5-01.s.s1.prompt: Sharraxaaddee ee daahitaanka Jisu ayaa ku habboon DHAMMAAN afarta tilmaan (daahitaan, jawaab la'aanta wicitaannada, kabo qoyan, taleefan xiran)?
x-k-k5-01.s.s1.hint.0: Liis garee afarta tilmaan, kadibna sharraxaad kasta ku tijaabi dhammaantood, ma aha kan koowaad oo keliya.
x-k-k5-01.s.s1.hint.1: Barbardhig intee ka mid ah afarta tilmaan sharraxaad kasta ay dabooto, oo xus tilmaamaha ay sharraxaad la'aan ka tagto.
x-k-k5-01.s.s1.o.a: Way hurdo-badatay, kadibna way degdegtay makhaayadda iyadoo aan hubin taleefankeeda.
x-k-k5-01.s.s1.r.a: Tani waxay sharxaysaa daahitaanka, laakiin waxba kuma jiraan sharaxa kabaha qoyan. Hubi sharaxaad kasta tilmaan kasta.
x-k-k5-01.s.s1.o.b: Waxaa ku soo qabsaday roob jidka, taleefankeeduna halkaas ayuu ku damay.
x-k-k5-01.s.s1.r.b: Tani waxay sharxaysaa daahitaanka, kabaha qoyan iyo wicitaannada la seegay wada. Wada hadalku ma caddeeyo roob, laakiin waa sheekada aan tilmaan sharaxaad la'aan ka tagin.
x-k-k5-01.s.s1.o.c: Waxay illowday kulanka ilaa saaxiib ay wacay si uu u weydiiyo halka ay joogto.
x-k-k5-01.s.s1.r.c: Haddii taleefankeedu dansanaa, cidina kuma gaari kareen wicitaan, iyaduna waxay ka cafis weydiisanaysaa daahitaan, ma aha illawid.
x-k-k5-01.s.s1.o.d: Ma rabin inay timaaddo, sidaas darteed si ula kac ah ayay u daahday oo iska indho tirtay wicitaannada.
x-k-k5-01.s.s1.r.d: Qoraalku wuxuu muujiyaa cafis (정말 죄송해요) iyo dhib wax ku ool ah (taleefan dansan). Waxba ma tilmaamaan rabitaan ah inay ka fogaato kulanka.
x-k-k5-01.s.s1.explain: Kabaha qoyan iyo taleefan dansanaa waxay tilmaamaan hal dhacdo jidka ah (cimilo ama shil) oo sharxaysa dhawr tilmaan hal mar. Roobku waa sabab suurtagal ah laakiin lama caddayn: kayd biyo ah ama cabitaan daadsan sidoo kale way ku habboonaan lahaayeen.
x-k-k5-01.s.s2.prompt: Ingiriis ahaan, magacaaw LABADA tilmaan ee ugu badan taageera doorashadaada, adigoo ka xigaya Kuuriyaanka mid kasta, sheeg sababta mid kastaa u taageerto, oo magacaaw hal shay oo kale oo sidoo kale dhici kari lahaa.
x-k-k5-01.s.s2.hint.0: Ka xig si sax ah erayada xambaarsan tilmaanta.
x-k-k5-01.s.s2.hint.1: Is weydii: maxaa kale oo kabaha ka dhigi kara qoyan ama taleefanka ka dami kara?
x-k-k5-01.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ma labadayda tilmaan waxay ka yimaadeen wada hadalka laftiisa, ma aha male-awaalkayga?
x-k-k5-01.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ma 'suurtagalnimada kale' runtii way ka duwan tahay sharaxaaddayda ugu weyn?
x-k-k5-01.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Ma sheegay sababta tilmaan u muhiim tahay, ma aha inaan koobiyeeyo oo keliya?
x-k-k5-01.s.s2.model.0: '신발이 다 젖어 있었어요' wuxuu muujiyaa inay banaanka joogtay cimilo qoyan, '휴대폰이 꺼져서'-na wuxuu sharxaa sababta aysan ugu jawaabi karin wicitaannada. Wada jir ahaan waxay tilmaamaan roob iyo taleefan dansan, laakiin waxay sidoo kale kayd biyo ku dhici kartay, sidaas darteed ma hubo.
x-k-k5-01.s.s2.model.1: Laba tilmaan: '전화를 해도 안 받았어요' iyo '신발이 다 젖어 있었어요'. Waxay tilmaamaan inay jidka ku jirtay taleefan aan shaqaynayn. Laga yaabo in baytariga taleefanku dhammaaday, ama taleefanku qoyay; ma hubi kartaa kee.
x-k-k5-01.s.s2.modelNote.1: Lammaane tilmaan kala duwan iyo beddel kala duwan; labaduba waa sax.
x-k-k5-01.s.s2.model.2: Kabaha qoyan (신발이 다 젖어 있었어요) iyo taleefan dansan (휴대폰이 꺼져서) waxay ku habboon yihiin sheeko ah in ay qooyday jidka. Waxay halkii roob ku dhici kartay kayd biyo.
x-k-k5-01.s.s2.model.3: Tilmaamaha ugu xooggan: '신발이 다 젖어 있었어요' wuxuu inoo sheegayaa inay banaanka joogtay cimilo qoyan, '휴대폰이 꺼져서'-na wuxuu sharxayaa wicitaannada la seegay. Suurtagalnimo kale: way ku dhacday kayd biyo taleefankuna wuu qooyay.

x-k-k5-02.title: Usbuuca dhammaadkiisa Hana ma isku darmo
x-k-k5-02.goal: Hel labada sadar ee wada hadal gaaban ee aan labaduba run noqon karin, kadibna hagaaji sheekada Kuuriyaan waqti tegay dabiici ah.
x-k-k5-02.material: Isniinta subaxdii, shaqaale la shaqeeya ayaa weydiiyey Hana usbuuca dhammaadkiisa.
x-k-k5-02.prereq.0: Wuxuu akhriyaa weedho waqti tegay (-았/었어요) iyo erayada waqtiga (하루 종일, 저녁)
x-k-k5-02.s.s1.prompt: Laba sadar oo Hana ah labaduba run noqon karin. Guji MID ka mid ah (mid kasta wuu tirsanayaa).
x-k-k5-02.s.s1.hint.0: Hoos u xariiq maalinta iyo waqtiga maalinta sadar kasta.
x-k-k5-02.s.s1.hint.1: Is barbar dhig waxa sadar Sabti kasta sheegto oo ku saabsan meesha Hana ay joogtay.
x-k-k5-02.s.s1.explain: Sadarrada 2 iyo 4 way is khilaafsan yihiin: 'maalin dhan guriga' (하루 종일 집에서) run noqon karin haddii ay Sabtida fiidkii ku jirtay arooska. Sadarka 3 wuxuu ku saabsan yahay Axadda, sidaas darteed qayb kama aha is-khilaafka.
x-k-k5-02.s.s2.prompt: Dib u qor HAL ka mid ah labada sadar ee is-khilaafsan Kuuriyaan (waqti tegay, qaab edeb leh) si labada sadar ee Hana labaduba run u noqon karaan. Ilaali weedha ku saabsan usbuuca dhammaadkiisa Hana.
x-k-k5-02.s.s2.hint.0: Go'aami kee labada sadar ee aad beddelayso, kadibna weydii maxaa saxda ah ee labada sadar is-khilaafiya.
x-k-k5-02.s.s2.hint.1: Beddel waqtiga ama howsha si labada sadar ee Sabtida ay labaduba run u noqon karaan isla maalinta.
x-k-k5-02.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ma labadayda sadar ee Sabtida hadda labaduba isla mar run noqon karaan?
x-k-k5-02.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ma beddelay inta ugu yar ee suurtagal ah?
x-k-k5-02.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Ma weedhaydu waa Kuuriyaan dabiici ah (particles, dhammaad waqti tegay)?
x-k-k5-02.s.s2.modelNote.1: Wuxuu beddelaa sadarka labaad halkii; sidoo kale waa sax.
x-k-k5-02.s.s2.modelNote.2: Wuxuu hagaajiyaa sadarka 2: jirrada, laakiin fiidkii way fiicnaatay.
x-k-k5-02.s.s2.modelNote.4: Wuxuu u dhaqaajiyaa arooska maalin kale; sidoo kale waa sax.

x-k-k5-04.title: Sabti ku habboon jadwalka
x-k-k5-04.goal: Hel dhawr qorshe oo kala duwan oo buuxiya dhammaan qaanuunnada waqtiga ee fariinta saaxiib, kadibna saaxiibka u sheeg qorshahaaga Kuuriyaan.
x-k-k5-04.material:
친구의 문자 (fariin qoraal ah oo saaxiib):
토요일 계획이에요.
- 오전 11시에 만나요.
- 점심은 늦어도 오후 1시에는 먹기 시작할 거예요. 점심은 1시간 걸려요.
- 점심을 다 먹은 뒤에 영화를 볼 거예요. 영화는 2시간이에요. 낮 12시, 오후 2시, 오후 4시에만 시작해요.
- 영화가 끝나면 바로 집에 갈 거예요. 극장에서 집까지 1시간 걸리고, 저녁 6시까지 집에 와야 해요.
x-k-k5-04.thinking.1: Helitaanka in ka badan hal qorshe oo dhammaantood buuxiya
x-k-k5-04.thinking.2: Hubinta qorshe iyadoo la eegayo qaanuun kasta
x-k-k5-04.prereq.0: Wuxuu akhriyaa waqtiyada saacadda Kuuriyaan (오전, 오후, 낮 12시) iyo tirooyin + 시
x-k-k5-04.s.s1.prompt: Qor saddex qorshe oo kala duwan oo buuxiya qaanuun kasta. Isticmaal lambarka 24-saac ee waqtiga bilowga (낮 12시 = 12, 오후 2시 = 14, 오후 4시 = 16). Qadadu waxay bilaabmaa l; filimku waxa uu bilaabmaa m.
x-k-k5-04.s.s1.hint.0: Hubi hal qaanuun mar; ku bilow helitaanka waqtiyada filimka ee waligood shaqayn kara.
x-k-k5-04.s.s1.hint.1: Marka hore dooro waqtiga filimka, kadibna weydii waqtiyada bilowga qadada ee ku habboon ka hor.
x-k-k5-04.s.s1.ok.c1: Qadadu waxay bilaabmaa saacad dhan inta u dhexeysa 11 iyo 13.
x-k-k5-04.s.s1.fail.c1: Qadadu waa inay bilaabmaan ka dib kulanka 11:00 oo aan ka dambeynin 13:00, saacad dhan.
x-k-k5-04.s.s1.ok.c2: Filimku wuxuu bilaabmaa waqti la muujiyey.
x-k-k5-04.s.s1.fail.c2: Filimadu waxay bilaabmaan 12, 14 ama 16 oo keliya.
x-k-k5-04.s.s1.ok.c3: Filimku wuxuu bilaabmaa ka dib dhammaadka qadada.
x-k-k5-04.s.s1.fail.c3: Qadadu waxay qaadataa 1 saac waana in la dhammeeyo ka hor intaan filimku bilaabmin.
x-k-k5-04.s.s1.fail.c4: Filimku wuxuu socdaa 2 saacadood safarka guriga-na 1 saac; waa inaad guriga joogtaa 18:00.
x-k-k5-04.s.s1.explain: Hal qaanuun wuxuu ka saaraa filimka 4 p.m. (wuxuu dhammaan lahaa 18:00 oo wakhti ma hadhi lahayn safarka), qaanuun kale-na wuxuu u baahan yahay in qadadu dhammaato ka hor filimka. Afar qorshe ayaa hadha.
x-k-k5-04.s.s2.prompt: U dir qorshahaaga saaxiibkaa Kuuriyaan (qaab edeb leh): dheh goorta aad cuni doonto qadada iyo goorta aad arki doonto filimka.
x-k-k5-04.s.s2.hint.0: Isticmaal qorshe aad dhisatay tallaabadii hore.
x-k-k5-04.s.s2.hint.1: Dhig waqtiga ka hor 에, howshana ka hor 을/를.
x-k-k5-04.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ma fariintaydu waxay waafaqsan tahay mid ka mid ah qorshayaasha ku gudbay qaanuunnada?
x-k-k5-04.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ma labada waqti way cad yihiin saaxiibkayga?
x-k-k5-04.s.s2.modelNote.1: Wuxuu isticmaalaa qorshe kale oo sax ah.

x-k-k5-08.title: Yaa joogay maktabadda?
x-k-k5-08.topic: sheekooyin is khilaafsan oo ku saabsan dhacdo hore
x-k-k5-08.goal: Miizaanso saddex sheeko oo ku saabsan isla galabta, oo sheeg waxa la gabagabeyn karo iyo waxa aan la gabagabeyn karin, ka dibna magacaaw hab lagu ogaado wax dheeraad ah.
x-k-k5-08.material:
Fasalku wuxuu dhammaadaa 3:30. Guriga Minsu waa 30 daqiiqo socod dugsiga, wuxuuna had iyo goor lugeeyaa (bas ma jiro). Saddex fasalle ayaa hadlaya maalinta xigta.
민수: 어제 수업이 끝나고 바로 집에 갔어요.
하나: 어제 4시쯤 도서관에서 민수 씨를 봤어요. 책을 빌리고 있었어요.
준호: 저는 4시 30분쯤 도서관에 있었는데 민수 씨는 못 봤어요.
x-k-k5-08.thinking.1: Kala saarista waxa la caddeeyay iyo waxa kaliya waafaqsan
x-k-k5-08.prereq.0: Wuxuu akhriyaa hadalada wakhtiga (쯤, 바로, 끝나고)
x-k-k5-08.s.s1.prompt: Maxaad ka gabagabeyn kartaa saddexda sheeko?
x-k-k5-08.s.s1.hint.0: Ka shaqee goorta Minsu guriga joogi lahaa haddii uu isla markiiba baxo.
x-k-k5-08.s.s1.hint.1: Is barbardhig wakhtiga sheeko kasta iyo kuwa kale: lammaane ma ka koobaa isla daqiiqad?
x-k-k5-08.s.s1.o.a: Sheekooyinka Hana iyo Minsu way isku dhacaan, kan Junho-na ma go'aamiyo u dhexeeya
x-k-k5-08.s.s1.r.a: Minsu guriga ma joogi lahaa ka hor 4:00 haddii uu si toos ah guriga ugu lugeeyo, sidaas darteed ma noqon karo sidoo kale maktabadda 4:00; wakhtiga Junho waa mid kale.

x-k-k5-08.s.s1.r.b: Hal sheeko ayaa la isku dhacay kale, laakiin isku dhac ma muujiyo yaa khaldan ama haddii qof been sheegay.
x-k-k5-08.s.s1.o.c: Hana waa inay khaldantahay, sababtoo ah Junho wuxuu joogay maktabadda dambe oo ma arkin Minsu
x-k-k5-08.s.s1.r.c: Junho wuxuu yimid nus saac ka dib wakhtiga Hana bixisay, sidaas darteed sheekadiisu waxba ka sheegto 4:00.
x-k-k5-08.s.s1.o.d: Saddexda sheeko dhammaantood isku mar waa run noqon karaan, sababtoo ah qofna wakhti saacad ma bixin
x-k-k5-08.s.s1.r.d: Guriga 4:00 iyo amaahda buug maktabadda 4:00 labadaba hal qof run noqon karin.
x-k-k5-08.s.s1.explain: Lugeynta toos ah ee guriga waxay qaadataa ilaa qiyaastii 4:00, sidaas darteed Minsu ma noqon karo maktabadda 4:00. Ama Minsu ama Hana ayaa khaldan (ama 'wax yar ka dib 4' waa loo jeedaa si dabacsan). Junho wuxuu yimid 4:30, sidaas darteed waxba kama muujiyo 4:00.
x-k-k5-08.s.s2.prompt: Ingiriis ahaan, magacaaw hal wax aad weydiin lahayd ama hubin lahayd si aad u ogaato yaa sax ah, adigoo soo xigaya erayada Kuuriyaanka ee kaa dhigay inaad shakisato.

x-k-k5-08.s.s2.hint.1: Hubin wanaagsan waa wax qof runtii sameyn karo.
x-k-k5-08.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Hubintii aan soo jeediyay ma runtii kala saari lahayd suurtagalnimada?

x-k-k5-08.s.s2.model.0: Weydii Hana inta ay hubto '4시쯤' iyo inay la hadashay, weydii Minsu goorta uu guriga yimid, maadaama '바로 집에 갔어요' ay macnaheedu yahay inuu guriga joogay ilaa 4:00.
x-k-k5-08.s.s2.model.1: Hubi diiwaanka amaahda maktabadda: haddii Minsu amaahday buug qiyaastii '4시쯤' markaas Hana waa sax; Junho's '4시 30분쯤' waa nus saac ka dib, sidaas darteed waxba ma xaliso.

x-k-k5-09.topic: qorista wakhtiga tegay si sababta looga gabagabeyn karo

x-k-k5-09.thinking.2: Qorista erayada sababta caadiga ah la'aan

x-k-k5-09.s.s1.prompt: Labada qoraal kuwee ayaa sababta LAGU SHEEGIN erayo, laakiin akhriste weli qiyaasi karo?

x-k-k5-09.s.s1.r.b: Eray sabab ah ma muuqdo, haddana 병원, 약 iyo 누웠어요 wada jir ahaan waxay u oggolaadaan akhristaha inuu qiyaaso jirro.
x-k-k5-09.s.s1.r.c: Eray sabab ah ma muuqdo, haddana dallaayad la'aan iyo dhar qoyan waxay u oggolaadaan akhristaha inuu qiyaaso roob.
x-k-k5-09.s.s1.r.d: '그래서' wuxuu si toos ah u sheegayaa sababta iyo natiijada.
x-k-k5-09.s.s1.explain: Gudaha b iyo c akhristuhu waa inuu isku xiraa faahfaahino (isbitaal + dawo, ama dallaayad la'aan + dhar qoyan). Gudaha a iyo d eray sabab ah (-아서, 그래서) ayaa si cad u sheegaya.
x-k-k5-09.s.s2.prompt: Qor 2-3 weedhood oo Kuuriyaan ah oo ku saabsan wax dhacay toddobaadkii hore (kaaga ama mid la sameeyay) si sababta hal shay aan loo sheegin laakiin la qiyaasi karo. Ha isticmaalin dhammaad sabab (-아서/어서/해서, -니까), 그래서, 때문에 ama 이유. (가서/와서 oo loola jeedo 'tag ka dibna samee' waa fiican yahay.)
x-k-k5-09.s.s2.hint.0: Marka hore dooro sababta, ka dibna dooro laba faahfaahin oo tilmaamaya iyadoon magacaabin.
x-k-k5-09.s.s2.hint.1: Hubi -아서, -어서, 그래서 ka hor intaadan dhammayn.

x-k-k5-09.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ma ka fogaaday eray sabab toos ah kasta?
x-k-k5-09.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Weedh kasta ma ku jirtaa wakhtiga tegay oo dabiici ah?
x-k-k5-09.s.s2.modelNote.1: Sababta kabaha la iibsaday waa loo daayay akhristaha.
x-k-k5-09.s.s2.modelNote.2: Jirrada waa loo daayay akhristaha; 가서 waa isku xigxig, ma aha sabab.
